Elderly Bengaluru Man Dies After Falling From 18th Floor Apartment

A 72-year-old man died after falling from the 18th floor of his apartment building in Bengaluru. The incident occurred while the man was reportedly cleaning his balcony. Police are investigating the death and suspect suicide.
